# Diana

[Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society)

- **Age:** eighteen (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P24](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0024), [v3 ch.Change P17](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0017)</sub>  
  _previously: 13 (v1)_  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) (relative), [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) (relative), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with rosy, crimson cheeks and dark features, including black eyes, a black head, and glossy, jet-black curls. She is described as slightly plump with the dearest dimples.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P12](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0012), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P5](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0005), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039)_

## Personality

Diana is a practical, good, and intelligent individual who shows an unselfish admiration for the talents and graces of her friends. She is particularly skilled at making lettuce salad and possesses a notable taste in dressing, leading others to frequently seek her advice on fashion.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P9](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0009), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P2](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0002), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P25](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0025), [v3 ch.Atonement” P59](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0059)_

## History

Named by a schoolmaster who was boarding at her home when she was born, Diana spent her childhood at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). As a girl, she learned a fancy crochet stitch from her aunt in [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), imagined ghosts in the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood), helped form a schoolgirl story club, named local landmarks alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), and vowed eternal friendship with [Anne](../character/anne.md) in the garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). When Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) mistakenly believed [Anne](../character/anne.md) had deliberately gotten Diana drunk, Diana was forbidden from playing with her, leading to a tearful farewell until [Anne](../character/anne.md) saved [Minnie](../character/minnie.md) May's life and restored their bond. Together, the two friends shared many adventures, including accidentally leaping onto [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) in a spare room bed, securing an antique willow-ware platter from Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) [Copp](../character/copp.md), and discovering Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). As they grew older, Diana was the one who delivered the news of Anne's tie for first place on the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams, and she later secretly submitted Anne's short story to a baking powder contest, resulting in a prize win. In time, Diana fell in love with [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), and [Anne](../character/anne.md) helped her prepare for their wedding at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). Four years into her marriage, Diana welcomed a new baby, and she was later present at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to see [Anne](../character/anne.md) marry [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

## Quotes

> “Yes,” said Diana, tossing her head, “but I’m sure he doesn’t like Julia Bell so very much. I’ve heard him say he studied the multiplication table by her freckles.”
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019)

> “Those Pye girls are cheats all round,” said Diana indignantly, as they climbed the fence of the main road. “Gertie Pye actually went and put her milk bottle in my place in the brook yesterday. Did you ever? I don’t speak to her now.”
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)

> "Why, he makes fun of all the girls. He laughs at mine because it’s so black. He’s called me a crow a dozen times; and I never heard him apologize for anything before, either."
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)

> "I do think you’re mean. What shall I do? Mr. Phillips will make me sit with that horrid Gertie Pye—I know he will because she is sitting alone. Do come back, Anne."
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P74](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0074)

> “The nicest I ever drank,” said Diana. “It’s ever so much nicer than Mrs. Lynde’s, although she brags of hers so much. It doesn’t taste a bit like hers.”
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P26](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0026)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--diana.md)

Diana and [Anne](../character/anne.md) are devoted, inseparable best friends. Though their friendship faced early trials—such as Diana accidentally becoming intoxicated on currant wine at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and her mother temporarily forbidding them from playing together—their bond was solidified after [Anne](../character/anne.md) saved Diana's sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) from croup. They share secrets, imaginative games, academic experiences, and romantic farewells, remaining constant companions.

- Friend of — close and affectionate friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P58](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0058), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P93](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0093), +47 more</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana.md)

Diana and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) share a passionate and enduring childhood friendship. They weather early misunderstandings, including a temporary ban imposed by Diana's mother after a accidental wine-serving mishap, which was happily resolved when [Anne](../character/anne.md) saved Diana's sister's life. From school games and midnight escapades to quiet walks and celebrating academic successes, Diana remains Anne's closest confidante.

- Friend of — best chums and schoolmates  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P3](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), +15 more</sub>

### [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-josephine--diana.md)

[Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) is Diana's great-aunt. Their relationship hits a temporary snag when Diana and [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally jump onto her in bed during a late-night game, infuriating the old lady and threatening Diana's music lessons. However, after [Anne](../character/anne.md) makes amends, [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) grows fond of both girls, sending gifts such as slippers to Diana for [Anne](../character/anne.md) and inviting them to her [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) estate for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition).

- Relative of — aunt  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P42](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011), +1 more</sub>
